hook: A privacy watchdog says: don't buy AI smart glasses.

beats.say: The Dutch data protection authority tested six AI smart glasses, priced from under one hundred to over five hundred euros.
In a simulated emergency, one pair repeatedly claimed an ambulance was on its way, though no one had been called.
Others misread medicine instructions and gave dating advice about a minor. The watchdog advises against buying them, but stopped short of a ban.
